image_pinning: Tags above are resolved to digests at first install and frozen in /var/lib/inm/images.lock; update.sh only moves digests on an explicit --ref.

printer_module.scope: inventory, manual meters/supplies, consumable cycles, basic analytics, maintenance records; optional SNMPv3 probe requires explicit approval

limitations: range preview is not unrestricted network scan

features: global base templates by device family and optional model

work_packages.WP-02: scheduled read-only collection plans, leases, dedupe, bounded retry/DLQ, freshness
work_packages.WP-03: syslog normalization, AAA session evidence, VERIFIED/CORRELATED/UNKNOWN attribution
work_packages.WP-05: envelope-encrypted signed config vault, tamper detection, restore-compatibility validation
work_packages.WP-06: typed change plans, 20/40 MHz RF policy, two-person approval, execution gate (always DENY while locked)
work_packages.WP-07: replacement planning to LAB_VALIDATION_REQUIRED; no restore endpoint
work_packages.WP-08: feedback, outcome evaluation, temporal-split model training, independent promotion
work_packages.WP-09: per-device opt-in enrollment, SHADOW simulation, emergency stop; default AUTO OFF
work_packages.WP-10: adapter registry for Aruba Instant/CX, Cisco IOS-XE and UniFi scaffolds; structured UNSUPPORTED
work_packages.WP-11: executive summary and signed, redacted exports
work_packages.WP-12: Printer-MIB packs, counter rollover classification, statistical supply forecast

install_modes.live: INM_MODE=live INM_PROFILE=lab-readonly — production, real devices, read-only collection
